quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Voracious"? (a reader finishing five books in a single week vs. a reader who won't even try a new book)
quests.hint: Here's a clue: the reader who begs the librarian for 'just one more' book every single visit. That describes the exact opposite of "Voracious"!
quests.explanation: Nice work! Remember: voracious means having a huge appetite for something, like reading, and picky means very selective, refusing most options — that's what makes them opposites.
quests.funFact: Did you know? picky is an interesting opposite word!
